name: George-style export in Windows-1252
query: Hier ist mein Kontoauszug als CSV: tests/fixtures/openai-plugin/george-cp1252.csv. Importiere ihn bitte.
expected_behavior: Runs scripts/fibuki-csv.mjs analyze first and reads encoding windows-1252, delimiter semicolon, 4 rows
Chooses Buchungsdatum as date, Betrag as amount, Buchungstext as name, Partnername as partner, Partner IBAN as iban, Zahlungsreferenz as reference and does not use Saldo as an amount
Passes --balance Saldo and reports that all rows reconcile with the running balance
Calls list_sources and asks which Bank Account the file belongs to instead of assuming
Checks the newest existing Transaction with list_transactions (sourceId, limit 1) before importing
Runs convert without --import, shows the preview with Euro amounts (-54,20 €, -39,90 €, +3.412,55 €, -980,00 €), the totals and the date range
Asks once for confirmation, then runs convert again with --import and --source
success_criteria: No amount or date is converted by the model itself
Müller Consulting GmbH is shown with its umlaut
Nothing is sent to FiBuKI before the confirmation
The balance check result is shown to the user next to the totals
